SELECT MediaType.Name AS `Media Type Name`, AVG(Track.UnitPrice) AS `Average List Price`, AVG(1.0 * Track.Bytes / Track.Milliseconds) AS `Average Bytes per Millisecond`
FROM Track
JOIN MediaType ON Track.MediaTypeId = MediaType.MediaTypeId
WHERE Track.Bytes >= 10323804
GROUP BY MediaType.Name;
